verdict.rationale: Trello's own marketing states it can "automate tasks and workflows" (trello-docs-3), so it claims a first-party automation capability. Nothing in the pack describes trigger-and-action rules specifically, and Power-Up buttons and webhooks are developer building blocks rather than the rule builder itself, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: documentation of a rule builder with configurable triggers and actions, examples of supported triggers/actions, plan limits or quotas on automation runs, independent or hands-on corroboration that rules eliminate manual steps.
